sessionCookie.name: laravel_session
sessionCookie.description: Tên session cookie thực lấy config. Dùng Sanctum first-party session + CSRF; auth cookie này minh họa.

RegisterInput.description: Ít nhất email hoặc phone, normalize và unique server-side; role không được nhận từ request.

identifier.description: Email hoặc phone VN đã normalize

sold_count.description: Verified accepted paid order item quantities; present on bestseller queries only.

discount_percent.description: Rounded percentage derived from persisted prices.
Server calculates sale_price in integer VND; do not combine with sale_price.
Server calculates sale_price in integer VND; do not combine with sale_price.

QuoteInput.description: delivery requires address; pickup address null; server shipping defaults to25000 VND for delivery and0 for pickup. Quote validates/estimates without reserving stock.

ResolveCase.description: Không tự mark paid/thu tiền; refund resolution chỉ khi có verified refund record đủ, verified_unpaid chỉ khi provider evidence chắc chắn; version conflict409.

evidence_reference.description: Operator-supplied private evidence filename under storage/app/private/evidence; file must exist.

RefundInput.description: Chỉ ghi refund đã thực hiện ngoài hệ thống và verified; merchandise_amount + shipping_amount = amount; tổng refund <= receipt. Không tự chuyển tiền.
x-validation-rules: cumulative verified refunds <= original receipt amount

ImageUpload.description: JPEG/PNG/WebP, max5MiB, max8192px each dimension; MIME and filename extension validated. Deletion schedules idempotent file cleanup after commit.

result.description: Kết quả VNPAY ký trong return, chỉ để hiển thị; không phải bằng chứng paid.
